Woman Finds Green Lump In Her Garden And Realizes It’s Holding A Beautiful Life

The animal needed help ...

By Alana Francis-Crow
Published on March 26, 2026 at 7:00 PM
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 23:54
Instaread

The other day, a South Texas resident named Pam Lê Steele was watering plants in her backyard garden when she spotted a small green lump in the soil. As she bent down to investigate, she quickly realized that the green pod was a butterfly chrysalis.

When a caterpillar is ready to become a butterfly, they form a hard shell around their body called a chrysalis. Inside the chrysalis, the pupa metamorphoses into their adult form.

Lê Steele, who welcomes caterpillars and butterflies into her garden, is familiar with chrysalises. But this was the first time she’d ever seen one on the ground, and she was worried about what would happen if the chrysalis was left in the dirt.

“I was getting really overwhelmed, but wanted to make sure that I picked up the chrysalis, because if I left it down, it wouldn’t be able to emerge and it would die,” Lê Steele told The Dodo.

After carefully scooping up the chrysalis with a paper towel, Lê Steele attached the cocoon’s hook to the loosened fibers at the end of two Q-tips. Once she was certain the chrysalis was secured, she placed it in a safe spot in her garden and crossed her fingers that it would be OK.

By the next morning, Lê Steele observed that the chrysalis had gone from bright green to a darker, black-orange hue. Lê Steele knew this was a good sign — it meant the butterfly’s development was coming along well.

On the third day with the chrysalis, Lê Steele could tell that the butterfly was about to emerge. She checked on it every few minutes, anxiously awaiting the insect’s arrival.

“I was like, ‘I don’t want to go to work. I don’t want to go inside. I don’t want to do anything. I just want to sit here and just observe this butterfly and just make sure that … everything is secure, that it’s safe,’” Lê Steele said.

Lê Steele left for less than an hour to go get breakfast with her husband, and when she returned, sure enough, the chrysalis was empty. At first, she was devastated to have missed the big moment. But then, she spotted a stunning monarch butterfly testing out his new pair of wings.

Lê Steele couldn’t help but feel that the butterfly had stuck around to say thank you and goodbye. She’d gone through a difficult couple of years, and the beautiful winged animal’s presence felt like a good omen.

“It didn’t fly away until I put it on my finger and lifted it up,” Lê Steele said.

If you want to experience your own magical moment with a butterfly emerging from a chrysalis, consider creating a welcoming environment for the colorful insects in your yard or on your balcony. Monarch butterflies need all the help they can get, and thanks to kind people like Lê Steele, this stunning animal got to complete his life cycle.

“I think everyone should just go out and plant local native plants and milkweeds to help out all of these pollinators,” Lê Steele said.

Walmart Delivery Driver Drops Off An Order — And Gets The Sweetest Plea To Stay

“Something just told me to turn on the camera …”

By Ashley Ortiz

Paris Johnson’s delivery route was going off without a hitch last week, until she arrived at a new house for the first time. She pulled into the driveway, ready to carry a handful of Walmart bags to the door, when a large black dog came barreling towards her car.

The dog shocked Paris. She’d encountered cats on some of her past deliveries, but she wasn’t used to being confronted by a big dog. At first, she wasn’t sure she could trust him.

“Because of [his] size, it kinda intimidated me a little bit …” Paris told The Dodo.

After hesitating for a moment, Paris realized that the dog wasn’t aggressive, but excited to meet a new friend. She soon felt comfortable enough to try completing the delivery.

As soon as she stepped onto the driveway, however, the pup had other plans. He jumped up and wrapped his arms around Paris’ torso, nearly preventing her from carrying the shopping bags to the door.

Paris eventually made it to the front door, where she met the pup’s owners. That's when she learned that his name was Rex and that he absolutely loved people.

“The owner was like, ‘Oh, he’s super friendly,’” Paris said. “He was just a sweetheart, a big teddy bear.”

Paris dropped off the bags, then walked back to her car with Rex still wrapped around her waist. It was unlike anything she’d ever seen at work before, and she felt compelled to pull out her phone and document their heartwarming encounter.

“I’ve never really experienced an animal that loving,” Paris said. “Something just told me to turn on the camera …”

You can watch that footage here:

Rex continued hugging Paris as she pressed record, happily following her to her car. But every time she attempted to open the door and say goodbye, Rex intervened.

“He kept closing my door because he would not want me to go,” Paris said. “It was the cutest.”

Sadly, Paris couldn’t stay for long, as she had other deliveries to fulfill. She eventually coaxed Rex down and headed off to the next stop, still in awe of the healing encounter she’d just had.

“[T]he universe sends you exactly what you need on the days that you need it,” Paris said. “That unconditional love that Rex gave [me] that day was definitely something that was needed.”

Rex’s hugs lifted Paris’ mood and made her shift even better that day. She hasn’t returned to the pup’s house since then, but she’s eagerly hoping to reunite with him soon. And after realizing just how special dogs are, she’s opened up to the idea of one day having a Rex of her own.

“I hope to, at some point, have a fur baby like Rex that gives that type of love and affection the way that he did,” Paris said.
